title: Soul Feast #9: Sharing: Your Soul’s Intention
excerpt: In today’s soul feast, Gary Zukav expands on the concept of harmony, from the previous episode, and introduces another key intention of the soul – sharing.
bodyHtml:
In today’s soul feast, Gary Zukav expands on the concept of harmony, from the previous episode, and introduces another key intention of the soul – sharing. Moving beyond the idea of simply exchanging words or gifts, he redefines sharing as an act of deep connection, grounded in love and free of any agenda. 

Gary reflects on his own journey, including how his personal experiences have shifted his understanding of generosity, making sharing an act of the soul rather than the personality.

Gary invites listeners to explore the difference between sharing from a place of fear versus from a place of authentic power, where sharing becomes a true expression of one’s essence and presence.

He emphasizes that to truly connect with others, we must look within, using emotional awareness to guide whether we’re acting from love or fear. He offers a practical “soul step” exercise: carry a small journal and record moments when you’ve shared authentically, and when you’ve shared with an underlying desire for validation or recognition.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (01:10): Why sharing goes beyond external agreement and starts with inner alignment.
  • (04:05): How sharing, when done without a second agenda, becomes a powerful act of connection.
  • (08:32): Why authentic sharing comes from aligning with love rather than seeking personal gain.
  • (10:15): How tuning into our emotions helps us recognize when we’re sharing from love or fear.
  • (20:53): A practical exercise to help you deepen your understanding of true sharing.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Carry a small notebook with you daily to capture moments of sharing. After each experience, take a moment to reflect: Was your intention truly grounded in love, or did it carry an element of fear or self-interest? By practicing this awareness, you’ll gain powerful insights that help you align more deeply with your soul’s intention to share and to create authentic power.
